args.subject: Invitation: Book Club — Tuesdays at 7 PM (Local Library)
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I’d like to invite you to our book club that meets on Tuesday evenings at 7:00 PM at the local library. We’re currently reading mystery novels and would love to have you join our next meeting for discussion and refreshments.

Please let me know if you can make it — reply to this email to RSVP or ask any questions.

Best regards,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM. Highly recommend stopping by if you're nearby.

Best,

args.body:
